jobs.title: Sr Manager, Finance Business Partner (Commercial)
jobs.description:
The Mosaic Company (NYSE: MOS) is the world’s leading integrated producer of concentrated phosphate and potash—two of the three most important nutrients in agriculture. We employ more than 13,000 people in six countries to serve farmers all over the world. Our Headquarters is in Lithia, Florida with operations throughout North America (U.S./Canada) and South America.

At Mosaic We Help the World Grow the Food it Needs - Apply today and join our team!

The Senior Manager – Finance Business Partner (Commercial NA) will lead financial support for the Commercial business and Org, including overseeing China and India. This role will provide strategic financial insights, performance analysis, and decision support to drive growth, profitability, and operational excellence. The position will manage planning, forecasting, and reporting processes, and collaborate closely with regional and global stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, and Biosciences.

What you’ll do?
- Lead financial business partnering for the global Commercial team, including North America. Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decisions. Manage budgeting, forecasting, and performance tracking processes. Collaborate with Corporate FP&A to ensure accuracy and alignment of financial data. Support margin analysis, pricing strategies, Working capital optimization and Capital Investments.

- Act as a strategic advisor to business unit leadership. Participate in strategy development and execution. Provide financial modeling and scenario analysis to support initiatives, investments, and commercial strategies. Ensure alignment with Mosaic’s financial goals and compliance with internal policies.

- Lead and develop finance team members. Provide coaching, feedback, and career development support. Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture across finance and commercial teams.

What you’ll need:
- A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or related field.

- MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred

- 8+ years in finance or business, with strong experience in business partnering and performance management

- Experience in agribusiness or industrial sectors preferred

- SAP, Hyperion, Power BI preferred

- Strategic thinking, financial modeling, cost management, KPI tracking, leadership

- Solid proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel.

What's in it for you:
- A competitive base salary + bonus incentives

- 11 paid holidays each year

- A generous 401k with a company match and annual company contribution

- Paid sick leave

- Paid vacation time

- A robust benefits package which includes Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, life & disability

- Tuition reimbursement

- Paid Paternity/Maternity Leave

jobs.title: Talent Development Manager
jobs.description:
The Mosaic Company (NYSE: MOS) is the world’s leading integrated producer of concentrated phosphate and potash—two of the three most important nutrients in agriculture. We employ more than 13,000 people in six countries to serve farmers all over the world. Our Headquarters is in Lithia, Florida with operations throughout North and South America.

At Mosaic, we help the world grow the food it needs. Want to work somewhere meaningful? Apply today and join our team!

The Manager, Talent Management – Succession & Leadership Pipeline is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of succession planning and leadership pipeline strategies, aligned with enterprise talent priorities defined by the Senior Manager.   This role ensures robust and diverse talent pipelines for critical and leadership roles by strengthening succession processes, leadership development frameworks, and readiness strategies. The Manager translates enterprise talent strategy into scalable programs, tools, and governance that enhance leadership capability and mitigate talent risks.   Acting as a key partner to HR Business Partners and business leaders, this role provides expertise on succession, readiness, and pipeline development, leveraging data and insights to inform talent decisions and align with workforce planning and organizational priorities.

What will you do?

Succession Planning & Pipeline Management

- Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of succession planning processes for critical and leadership roles.

- Ensure strong governance, consistency, and data integrity across talent reviews.

- Monitor pipeline health, identify talent risks, and drive mitigation plans to strengthen leadership bench strength.

Leadership Development Frameworks & Capability Building

- Drive the deployment of leadership development frameworks aligned with enterprise competency models and business priorities.

- Ensure leadership capability building programs effectively support pipeline readiness and succession outcomes.

Talent Insights, Analytics & Executive Materials

- Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to guide succession, readiness, and leadership pipeline strategies.

- Provide expert advice on talent risks, development priorities, and internal mobility aligned with business needs.

- Ensure alignment of succession and leadership pipeline practices with Talent Management, Workforce Planning, and Talent Acquisition.

- Continuously enhance tools, frameworks, and processes, incorporating best practices and market trends.

What you'll need:

- A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or Related field.

- 7+ years of extensive knowledge in Talent Management, Organizational Development, or Human Resources with direct exposure to executive-level development, succession planning, and strategic workforce planning.

- Experience designing and delivering enterprise-wide talent programs

- Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders

- Deep knowledge of executive development, succession planning, performance and career development processes, with the ability to align strategies with execution plan

- Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to lead programs and multiple stakeholders

- Strong capability in managing complex initiatives, synthesizing talent needs into frameworks, and applying a product mindset to drive continuous improvement.

- Digital mindset

- Able of analytics driven by data

- Solid proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel

- Familiarity with modern HRIS systems, e.g. Workday, SAP and other applicable technology, e.g. PowerBI preferred.

What’s In It for You:
- An attractive base salary + an annual incentive

- 11 paid holidays each year

- 401k with a company match and annual company contributions

- Paid sick leave for when you need it

- A robust benefits package which includes Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

- A hybrid working schedule

- Outstanding growth opportunities, both within Mosaic and for your skillset
